candidates.title: Ratchet Run
candidates.observedWeakness: Short five-route progression offered only passive suspension choices, no cargo-recovery decision, and no active equipment. Direct rendered play additionally exposed short hop/kit taps disappearing between animation frames.
candidates.before: Two suspension settings; optional parcels and best ghosts; broken straps could not be repaired.
candidates.after: Two unlocked field kits with finite supplies and handling costs: stop to fit spare straps and lighten the rack, or spend spring charges on higher hops with harder landing risk. Separate verified kit records and ghosts preserve classic records. Steady-pedal toggle supports relaxed keyboard/touch use, braking overrides and pause clears it. Short hop/kit taps are now buffered, and route badges refresh for the chosen kit.
testing: 40 engine and 36 DOM Ratchet checks passed, including ten kit deliveries and all unchanged classic routes.
https://github.com/ThatOneMop/study-desk/actions/runs/40038858541 — all seven jobs successful; 659 engine/DOM checks and all seventeen native desktop/touch suites.

Native keyboard and multi-touch: ten kit deliveries per mode, spent-resource reload, separate records, loss/retry, short tap/reload, save recovery, restart, navigation and unmocked riding/steady-pedal/braking.

Direct rendered play: original Milk Run three seals; spring-kit Canal Cut three seals after an observed loss/control fix/retry; spare-strap Cobble Exchange two seals after two actual repairs, mid-route reload and subsequent unlock. Restart cancel/confirm and return link checked.
